Ree cleans out her fridge and uses up food that's on its way out; she creates a lemon rice pudding with leftover lemons; the produce drawer is transformed into a Fridge Gazpacho; she creates marinade for grilled Tex-Mex Chicken and Chicken Alfredo.

Ree Drummond is hoping to score big with dinner for the boys after quarterback training.

description:

Ree Drummond downsizes dinner now that all her kids are grown and gone; she makes a small but scrumptious sausage and peppers 1/4 sheet pan pizza, and just the right amount of creamy pesto pasta.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:

Ree Drummond cleans out her kitchen by turning leftovers into dishes; she transforms her pantry and fridge odds and ends into Brown Sugar Buttermilk Waffles and more.

description:

description:

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E04 — Halloween Word Games
Bennett challenges the four remaining teams to create scenes based on three words; the pumpkin artists are in the spotlight as their monster must be completely made of pumpkin; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which teams move on.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S15 E05 — The Boogeyman's Lair
Host Bennett challenges seven teams of international cake, sugar and pumpkin artists to create spooky displays, complete with mouthwatering treats; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which team will walk away with $25,000.

title: Halloween Wars
description:

The final two teams create modern spell-casting scenes that include one special effect and three complete characters; it's up to Jonathan Bennett, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira to decide who will be crowned Halloween Wars champion and win $25,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:

Guy Fieri is challenging America's best chefs to compete in his ever-changing lineup of outside-the-box Flavortown restaurants, from food carts to fine dining; with $20,000 on the line, these chefs will need to be prepared for anything.

description:

description:

description:
